claim: SkoolKit's simulator applies the LD A,I quirk from its own 48K frame timing, not from the harness's interrupts, so a harness that injects its own interrupts must set int_active 0 where it delivers none.

evidence.text: The quirk (P/V 0) on its own 48K frame left interrupts off at random via HLIB_IFF_DI and hung a run; set int_active 0 and clear P/V only where the harness accepts an interrupt.
A direct-opcode scope must set int_active=0 when it does not deliver interrupts.
